# EmergentPatternFormation

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The spontaneous creation of complex, spatially-organized structures from simple local rules in NCA, without explicit global coordination. Underpins how distributed in-network neuromorphic elements can self-organize into functional topologies, reducing the need for centralized control.
